selection.rule: paired_correct==False in the saved pre-optimization16-dimensional method
selection.endpoint_label_source: existing pair metadata; no generated labels

MEGA_previous_controlled.description: Previously used MEGA controlled held-out input pairs; this is not the new7458-case official path set

NLI4CT_2024_native.description: Native released base/variant relations; same-label is not automatically semantic invariance

interpretation.error_conditioned_subset: These fixed error subsets are diagnostic, not a new independent generalization test; old paired correctness is zero by construction.
interpretation.MEGA_scope: The paired MEGA data were previously evaluated. They must not be reported as paired coverage of the new7458 official paths.
interpretation.normalization: MEGA correction_rms_over_full_raw_AP_rms uses the original full2293-pair raw AP RMS; error-pool RMS denominators are also explicit.
interpretation.NLI_scope: Native intervention names are retained, relation comes from actual released labels. Same-label Contradiction variants are not asserted semantically invariant.
interpretation.F0: Same-label fact changes are separate from nuisance A/P changes; their difference is not assumed to require elimination.
interpretation.response: Signed response retention is relative to raw response on the selected error subset, not an absolute truth score.
interpretation.regression: No new originally-correct whole-population scores computed; selected-pair counterpart endpoints are necessary references only.

scope: Fixed old_linear error pairs only; MEGA previous controlled 48, NLI native 2677. Not official7458 path-pair coverage.
